Container.Name: gangway-inabox
Container.Overview:
gangway in a box creates a Debian VM on this server that runs gangway, so previews run inside the VM and never touch Unraid's own Docker. gangway gives decks, dashboards and small apps their own HTTPS URL, from an agent (MCP), a pull request, or a folder dropped in the browser.
Pick how gangway is reached with Mode. proxy, the default, puts it behind a reverse proxy on this server (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG) on your own domain. lan needs no domain, to try it out: gangway answers at https://app.[VM IP].sslip.io:8443 on your network, and a preview goes public through its Share link. acme gives the VM ports 80 and 443 and a Let's Encrypt wildcard certificate over Cloudflare DNS.
Open the WebUI for the VM's address, its install progress and the one-time link that creates the first admin. The first boot takes a few minutes. Stopping this container leaves the VM running: it is an ordinary VM in the VM tab. Starting the container starts the VM if it is off.
Container.Requires: Unraid's VM service must be on (Settings > VM Manager), with hardware virtualisation enabled in the BIOS.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: proxy: behind a reverse proxy on this server, on your domain. lan: no domain, reachable on your network, to try it out. acme: the VM holds 80 and 443 with its own certificate (needs a Cloudflare API token). Read once, when the VM is created.

Config.Name: Domain
Config.Description: Required for proxy and acme: the base domain, e.g. preview.example.com. *.preview.example.com must point at the proxy (proxy) or at the VM (acme).

Config.Name: Cloudflare API token
Config.Description: acme only: a token with Zone:DNS:Edit on the domain.

Config.Name: Proxy address
Config.Description: proxy only: where the proxy connects from, as a CIDR. Empty means this server's address, which is right when the proxy is a container in bridge mode. A proxy on its own IP (br0) needs that IP, e.g. 192.168.1.20/32.

Config.Name: VM name
Config.Description: The VM's name in the VM tab, and its folder in the Domains share.

Config.Name: VM memory (MB)
Config.Description: Previews share it; 4096 fits a handful of small apps.

Config.Name: VM disk
Config.Description: Size of the VM's disk, grown as it fills.

Config.Name: VM network
Config.Description: Bridge the VM joins. Empty uses VM Manager's default (usually br0).

Config.Name: SSH key
Config.Description: Optional public key for the VM's debian user.

Config.Name: gangway version
Config.Description: Image tag the VM installs, e.g. latest or 0.3.2.

Config.Name: Status page port
Config.Description: Port of this container's status page. Change the WebUI link to match.

Config.Name: Domains share
Config.Description: Unraid's VMs share; the VM's disk goes in a folder here.

Config.Name: Libvirt socket
Config.Description: Unraid's VM manager, to create and start the VM. Required.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Read-only, to find where the Domains share is on the host. Required.

Config.Name: VM Manager settings
Config.Description: Read-only, for VM Manager's default network. Required.

Config.Name: VM icons
Config.Description: Where the gangway icon goes, so the VM tab shows it.
